title: aperiodic-dreaming
description: Morphism: experiences -> new claims. The APERIODIC dream (kappa >= omega_1): channels genuinely new facts/generators from OUTSIDE the fibers via an LLM enactor -- not derivable internally, so not a closure (that is the aperiodic regime). NETWORK. The most generative of the four dreams; finite/Scott-continuous/transfinite dreaming are its shadow collapsed down the regime tower. HACKING: name + regime placement admitted.
